# KanjiVG test fixtures

These six SVG files are copied unmodified from KanjiVG (tag `r20260714`, commit
`d95a97627fd9fe5b2c8d06ca81e38149609c0c1e`, directory `kanji/`): 語 `08a9e`, 言 `08a00`, 口 `053e3`,
五 `04e94`, the variant `04e14-Kaisho` and the kana あ `03042`. Each keeps its licence header.
